validated: Traveler, portal and foreground architecture exist as independent assets
VOIR and AGIR are explicitly locked
No production debug overlay and no Community section

blockers.title: Live render loses too much sharpness
blockers.detail: Independent review measured full-frame edge-energy collapse: Laplacian variance 2245 canon -> 1012 live rest (~55% loss) -> 605 live motion (~73% loss). The degradation is visible in typography, architecture and cards.

blockers.title: Rest state drifts visibly from canon
blockers.detail: Full-frame MAE is ~14.42 and SSIM ~0.587. The portal is over-bloomed and multiple scaled/screen-blended copies soften the exact canonical artwork.

blockers.title: Parallax is achieved partly by re-rendering/scaling large duplicate planes
blockers.detail: The whole stage rotation plus per-layer scale causes resampling blur. Screen blend on cloud/portal/gold layers adds luminosity not present in the canon.

blockers.title: Library remains a canonical flat scene
blockers.detail: Acceptable for the current Sanctuary milestone, but it must not be mistaken for a completed interactive Library.

acceptance_criteria_next: Rest-state browser render MAE <= 2.5 against canon
